Game Overview

Flight of The Viking is a arcade title where guide your Viking through the skies in a precarious biplane as speed intensifies, dodging obstacles with precision. Quick reflexes and perfect timing are vital for survival, while a witty twist awaits failures. Vibrant animations and increasing tempo keep the adrenaline soaring in this thrilling aerial escapade.
